thread:
incident-bot: P1 paging: High 5xx error rate observed on hosted inference API (us-west-2). Incident created: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2025-09-12-13

Priya S.: I'm on it. Seeing 30% 5xx on /v1/generate in prod us-west-2 around 13:12 UTC. Rolling errors across model variants.

Sam R.: Confirmed. Metric spike aligns with a failed autoscale event on the dedicated pool. Errors originate from grpc backend timeouts.

Priya S.: Quick mitigation: disabling batching for that pool and steering traffic to fallback pool. Executing now.

ops-sre: Copy. I'm switching routing policy to prefer regional fallback. Will monitor queue length and latencies.

Jordan (Product): Heads up — CS/marketing will want a status page + customer note. Can someone draft?

Emma (CS): Affected tenants: ~12 customers in us-west with heavy realtime usage. Two paying customers reported degraded responses. Need a concise customer-facing blurb.

Maya (Marketing): Draft for social and status page — will need legal sign-off. I'll propose tweet + status phrasing here for quick alignment.

Priya S.: Mitigation update: traffic steering done, errors down to ~8% and falling. KV cache warmed for fallback. Still seeing slower tail latency.

Sam R.: Long-term root cause telemetry: autoscaler failed to create new instances due to a transient quota error reported by the provider. We've queued a retry path to avoid full failures.

Taylor (Oncall): I'm starting the 30m handoff notes for next oncall. Current action items: 1) watch downstream retries; 2) validate routing fallback stable; 3) confirm no additional customer pages.

incident-bot: Event note: mitigation step applied at 13:24 UTC: traffic fallback enabled.

Maya (Marketing): STATUS PAGE DRAFT (short):

```
We are investigating elevated error rates for our hosted inference API in the US-West region. Our engineers have applied a temporary traffic routing change to reduce impact and are working on a permanent fix. Some customers may experience failed or delayed requests. We'll post updates here and notify affected customers directly.
```

Maya (Marketing): TWEET DRAFT: 

```
We're aware of elevated errors impacting hosted inference in US-West. Engineers have applied mitigations and service is recovering. We'll update on status.redwood.example shortly. Apologies for the disruption.
```

Ana (Legal): Quick note: avoid committing to root cause or timelines publicly. "Service is recovering" and "working on a permanent fix" are okay. Do not mention provider quotas explicitly in public messaging without escalation.

Jordan (Product): CUSTOMER EMAIL TEMPLATE (short):

```
Subject: Incident notice — Service disruption in US-West (some API requests failing)

Hi <Customer>,

We're investigating an issue causing increased errors for requests to our hosted inference API in US-West. Our engineers have applied temporary routing mitigations to reduce impact. You may see failed or delayed requests; we are monitoring closely and will follow up with a timeline and post-incident report.

If you are experiencing a critical outage, reply here and we will prioritize.

Thank you for your patience,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

Emma (CS): Adding: include link to status page and an option to open a high-priority support ticket. I'll start notifying the two impacted customers with this template.

Priya S.: Current numbers: 5xx rate ~5% now, avg latency back to SLO-ish, tail p99 elevated by ~200ms. No data exfiltration.

Sam R.: Next steps for engineering: 1) stabilize autoscaler retry path; 2) add guard to avoid total pool creation failure; 3) postmortem capture for change that triggered autoscale fizzle.

Maya (Marketing): Can Legal sign off on the status page + tweet phrasing? Need confirmation to publish.

Ana (Legal): Approved with edits. Replace "permanent fix" with "longer-term fix" and drop provider mention.

Maya (Marketing): Updated status + tweet with legal edits. Posting now.

incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.example at 13:38 UTC.

Taylor (Oncall): Handoff: monitoring for 2 hours, will escalate to infra-leads if 5xx > 10% for > 15m. Notes saved to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2025-09-12-13/notes

Priya S.: If routing keeps stable and autoscaler fix deploys in next deploy window we should be back to baseline. I'll coordinate the postmortem doc.

Jordan (Product): Social/PR alignment: I'll queue a short blog follow-up once root cause validated. Will coordinate with Maya and Ana for final wording.

Emma (CS): Customer notifications sent to impacted customers at 13:45 UTC. They acknowledged receipt.

Sam R.: Deploying autoscaler retry patch to canary in 10m.

Taylor (Oncall): Handing over to Sam for overnight watch. I'm out at 14:00 UTC. Leaving contact points in the doc. :wave:

incident-bot: Incident severity reduced to P2 at 13:56 UTC.

Priya S.: Final note: internal post-incident review scheduled tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Invite sent to eng, infra, product, marketing, legal, and CS.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — will lock the public post and PR messaging after postmortem. Please add any customer quotes or mitigations to the incident doc that should be public. :thumbsup:

Sam R.: Monitoring OK. Leaving extended logs in incident doc.

Priya S.: Closing thread in 1h unless we see regressions. Great coordination everyone.
